linked_rows.title: Public provider intake and asset boundary
Task-matched conformance and reproducible benchmark evidence
Provider integration boundaries and build fragments

disposition: Caller-supplied FP32 wav2vec2-base-960h encoder plus ridge rate-head readiness blocker; no implementation, adapter, asset or result.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the immutable upstream snapshot at revision 22aad52d435eb6dbaf354bdad9b0da84ce7d6156 with every file's byte count and SHA-256, the reviewed model card and license/notice bundle, and a redistribution/product-use decision.
exact_blockers.statement: The exact facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h weight snapshot is absent. The research source record pins model.safetensors at 377,607,901 bytes and SHA-256 8aa76ab2..., but no local file exists at the model checkpoint directory, data/checkouts, data/models or the Hugging Face cache. The smallest verifiable encoder reference cannot be built from metadata alone, and no weight was downloaded or reconstructed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply a locked offline environment with exact Python/torch/transformers/scikit-learn/numpy versions, wheel hashes, install/import digest, deterministic settings and one intra-op/one inter-op thread, then record a clean-room import and load.
exact_blockers.statement: No pinned runtime is present. Python 3.10.13 with torch 2.2.2, transformers 4.40.2, scikit-learn and numpy is required, but the available 3.11.5 interpreter exposes no torch, transformers or scikit-learn build for this task, and the historical data/envs/sylnet-py310 environment is absent. No import, load or inference was attempted.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply a serialized per-fold head artifact with SHA-256/byte count, or a reproducible head-training record that pins fold boundaries, feature dims, scaler statistics, alpha, library versions and the resulting artifact digest.
exact_blockers.statement: No ridge-head artifact is present. The historical pilot fitted a StandardScaler plus Ridge(alpha=10) head inside each of five chronological folds and saved only predictions in the results JSON; no joblib/npz head, scaler parameters, fold index or feature inventory was serialized. The FP32 embedding NPZ is a derived feature archive, not a head.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze a permitted, speaker/meeting-disjoint rate cohort with reviewed AMI/corpus and CMUdict terms, independently checked syllable labels, language/speaker groups and source-timestamp provenance.
exact_blockers.statement: The historical cohort is one AMI EN2003a meeting (210 four-second windows), not a rights-cleared multi-meeting rate corpus. Reference syllables come from AMI orthographic transcripts plus CMUdict 1.1.1 first pronunciations, not human syllable-nucleus labels. AMI audio/annotation and CMUdict terms have not been reviewed here, and no audio byte was read for this package.

exact_blockers.required_action: Run the FP32 encoder plus fitted ridge head on the qualified cohort with a frozen scorer, exact folds, finite-output checks, constant-fold-mean and zero-rate baselines, and adverse/missing controls.
exact_blockers.statement: No FP32 accuracy, nonnegative-rate, finite-output or baseline comparison was reproduced. The pilot's recorded MAE/RMSE/r, negative prediction count and timing are quoted context only; the archived FP32 embeddings are not loaded, scored or promoted, and no adverse, missing, invalid or nonfinite control was exercised against a real encoder.

exact_blockers.required_action: After model/data/runtime/quality gates clear, measure the exact target-device paced workload and complete the Rate profile, then open a separate OFF-by-default versioned provider intake with independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, adapter, descriptor or intake exists. The candidate has no SDK registration, no public ABI/registry/default/build or CI change, no target-device timing or resource measurement, and no reviewed rate-to-speed policy. The recorded 184 ms p95 is a historical CPU context, not a device or product result.

non_claims: No wav2vec2 weight, tokenizer asset or ridge-head artifact is present.
No torch, transformers, scikit-learn or numpy runtime is imported or executed.
No audio, transcript, syllable label or derived embedding is read or scored.
No FP32 accuracy, finite-output, baseline or timing result is reproduced.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
A syllables/second estimate is not a preferred speed factor or a TSM setting.

quality_outcomes.evidence: Recorded pilot FP32 CV is provenance only; no local score was reproduced.
The recorded post-hoc clip is not a locally reproduced result and does not define a product floor.
No nonfinite scan, minimum/maximum prediction bound or invalid/missing-input control was run against the real head.
The recorded training-fold-mean baseline is context only; no paired local comparison or zero-rate control exists.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: The candidate is a rate estimator, not a TSM renderer, and no source/output mapping or duration result exists.
No rendered output, F0/transient metric or listening result exists for a wav2vec2 plus ridge rate path.
No playback chain, queue, fill/flush or buffering measurement exists.
No 1x or rate-change comparison exists; a syllables/second estimate is not a speed factor.
The historical pilot is one AMI meeting of speech; no unfamiliar speech, music, silence or language coverage was tested.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, clock-drift or partial-window behavior was measured.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No pause/filler controller, source-timestamp mapping or speech-preservation measurement exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No preference/acceptability labels or rate-to-speed policy exists; none is inferred from the historical syllable-rate score.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map estimated rate to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Pin the exact source archive/tree and 40-hex revision, stage the complete model card and Apache-2.0 license/notice set, and record an independent terms review.
release_gates.statement: The upstream model revision is recorded from the research source record, but the immutable source archive/tree, complete model card, license and notice bundle are not staged or reviewed.
release_gates.title: source_revision_and_license_provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Supply the immutable weight snapshot with per-file digests and a reproducible/pinned ridge head, then verify both against the recorded source record.
release_gates.statement: No weight file or ridge-head artifact is present; only documented upstream digests and an in-memory per-fold fitting recipe exist.
release_gates.title: weights_assets_and_head_artifact

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide a locked offline runtime and install/import digest, load the pinned snapshot with networking disabled, fit or load the ridge head, and record deterministic repeat outputs.
release_gates.statement: The exact Python/torch/transformers/scikit-learn/numpy runtime is absent and no offline load, head fit or inference was executed.
release_gates.title: pinned_runtime_and_offline_load

release_gates.reopen_condition: Freeze a permitted, speaker/meeting-disjoint cohort with reviewed corpus and dictionary terms, independent syllable labels and source-timestamp provenance.
release_gates.statement: No rights-cleared multi-meeting rate cohort or human-checked syllable labels are staged; the historical pilot is one meeting with transcript-derived labels.
release_gates.title: rights_cleared_rate_corpus_and_labels

release_gates.reopen_condition: Reproduce the FP32 path on the qualified cohort with fixed folds and a frozen scorer, including accuracy/bias/correlation, finite-output and constant-fold-mean/zero-rate baselines.
release_gates.statement: No FP32 reproduction, finite-output scan, nonnegative-rate check or constant/zero baseline comparison is available; recorded numbers are not local results.
release_gates.title: fp32_accuracy_finite_output_and_baselines

release_gates.reopen_condition: Score the exact Rate-profile cases with separate source references and a timestamp-tied pause/filler policy, preserving speech and reporting duration/alignment.
release_gates.statement: The Rate profile is not exercised: no source/output mapping, duration, pitch/transient, buffering, rate-change, unfamiliar speech/music/silence, rebuffer/drift, final-partial-window or pause/filler decision evidence exists.
release_gates.title: rate_profile_condition_coverage

release_gates.reopen_condition: Measure the exact installed candidate under paced workload with p95/p99 callback/deadline, resource, thermal/energy and fill/flush behavior on the intended device.
release_gates.statement: No target-device timing, CPU/memory/energy, queue, deadline or rebuffer measurement exists. The historical FP32 CPU p95 is context only and not a device result.
release_gates.title: target_runtime_timing_resources_and_deadlines

release_gates.reopen_condition: Open a separate versioned, OFF-by-default opt-in provider intake with an exact asset/descriptor/config, clean-install proof and independent exact-head review after all prior gates clear.
release_gates.statement: No provider/intake/public-surface/release decision exists; the installed v0 geometry and shared build remain untouched.
release_gates.title: provider_intake_public_surface_and_release

required_artifacts.requirement: The exact historical neural-rate runner, nonnegative scoring script, upstream source record, results JSON, cohort manifest and derived FP32 embedding archive pinned by SHA-256.

The immutable facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h snapshot at revision 22aad52d435eb6dbaf354bdad9b0da84ce7d6156 with model.safetensors, config.json, preprocessor/feature-extractor configs and tokenizer assets, plus per-file byte counts and SHA-256.
A locked, offline runtime with Python 3.10.13, torch 2.2.2, transformers 4.40.2, scikit-learn and numpy versions, wheel hashes, one intra-op and one inter-op thread, and an install/import digest.

The fitted mean-pooled-feature ridge head (StandardScaler plus Ridge alpha=10) per fold, or a reproducible head-training record with exact fold boundaries, feature dims, seeds and a serialized artifact SHA-256.
A rights-cleared, held-out speech-rate cohort with permitted AMI audio, checked transcript-derived syllable labels, language and speaker/meeting groups, and more than one meeting.
A fresh FP32 run on the qualified cohort with a frozen scorer, exact folds, finite-output checks, constant-fold-mean and zero-rate baselines, and adverse/missing-input controls.
A separate versioned opt-in SDK provider intake with OFF default, empty descriptor settings, no registry/default/build change and independent exact-head review after every other gate clears.

required_results: Exact upstream snapshot revision, per-file byte counts and SHA-256.
Reviewed model-card, weight and notice terms plus product-use decision.
Serialized or reproducibly pinned per-fold ridge-head artifact.
Rights-cleared multi-meeting rate cohort with checked syllable labels.
Reproduced FP32 accuracy, finite-output and constant/zero baseline controls.
Exact Rate-profile mapping, buffering, condition and preservation evidence.
Target-device p95/p99 timing, resources and deadline behavior.
Separate OFF-by-default provider intake and independent exact-head review.

timing_requirements.evidence: No local encoder timing was measured.
No device, pacing or callback deadline was measured.
No resource, thermal or energy measurement exists.
